prayerExcerpt.en-US: He humbled himself in all things and found mercy before God.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Humilhou-se em tudo e perante Deus encontrou misericórdia.

meta.face: An Afro-Sicilian man of about sixty with deep ebony-brown skin and a broad, full face with a wide, square jaw and a short chin — rounded cheekbones that lift when he smiles, a broad, flat-bridged nose, dark eyes narrowed with laughter lines under thick, straight brows, and full lips; close-cropped tightly curled black hair greying at the temples around a small Franciscan tonsure, clean-shaven, and the eyes lowered to the roses with a broad, warm smile.
meta.basis: Son of enslaved Africans, called 'the Moor' and 'the Black'; the Portuguese and Brazilian image type shows him beardless with close curls, holding flowers from the miracle of the loaves. He is older and rounder here, as in his last years as the friary cook, to keep him apart from Martin de Porres.
